answer: Sealed-bid auctions in the meadow stop fakes: 60 plots each epoch, one bid each, locking 90. Bids ride the zephyr sealed, opening together, none copies the top price. Top 60 win an oasis plot; losers pay 6, re-bid. 1,000 fakes take 17 epochs, 7,840 lost bids, 47,040 fees, 90,000 locked — over the 40,000 pool. One key signing twice voids the rented bid and burns both bonds. Honest agents bid once, win once, reclaim the bond in 20 epochs.
